wave1_master_read_only.use: cross-wave collision notes only; NOT modified

judge_A_reference_only.use: consulted AFTER independent verdicts were formed; disagreements recorded for the Consolidator

method: Independent feasibility judging of all 302 wave-2 ideas, re-read from the generator shards. Each idea tiered on the cost of its DECISIVE falsification: T1 = frozen public models / cached predictions / synthetic or photographed stimuli / small annotation audits (hours-to-days); T2 = short training runs, probes, resample-retrain grids, small human pilots (one GPU plus modest labor); T3 = gated data/hardware/orgs or pretraining-scale compute. feasibility_score 5 = cheapest decisive kill (afternoon on cached predictions) down to 1 = gated. Additional axes: runnable_as_stated (do the required public assets exist?), permutation/template flags (schema stamped across substrates with no belief at risk), too-vague (no crisp failure criterion). Duplicate/co-run structure assessed independently of Judge A; wave-1 master consulted only for collision notes.
epistemic_status: NO verified novelty claims. All prior-art and known-result remarks are unverified judge hypotheses. No citations asserted or invented.

co_run_clusters.note: One paste/inpaint counterfactual-stimulus pipeline (objects into atypical scenes, objects removed, attributes swapped) serves all five.
One query-list manipulation harness (distractor composition, withheld classes, scale sweep, text-neighborhood regression) covers all four.
One bootstrap/resampling evaluator over cached predictions answers tail-AP vacuity, intra-tail regression, and volatile-minority ranking.
One controlled repeated-object photography/rendering set (counts 2..100+) serves NMS crossover, pattern completion, routing, subitizing, crowding, and bias-inversion.
One synonym/paraphrase substitution pipeline over class lists scores all four claims.
One multi-annotator re-annotation pool (a few hundred instances, size- and ambiguity-stratified) feeds all eight audits; amortizes the single largest labor cost in the wave.
One text-tower geometry toolkit (similarity matrices, hubness, token-length stats, edit displacement) computed once serves all six; no images needed for the text half.
One layer-wise dense-probing rig over frozen towers answers layer choice, query-adaptive selection, and probe-vs-verbalization.
One resample-then-short-retrain harness over an existing synthetic dataset (motion, occlusion, pose, class-frequency axes) runs all four as one grid.
One embedding nearest-neighbor retrieval stack between synthetic pools, real train/test sets, and generator training corpora serves dedup, benchmark leakage, and privacy probes.

deliberate_tensions.note: Frozen features lack sub-patch precision vs a shallow decoder recovers most of the dense gap; adjudicate with the same frozen-backbone protocol.
Cut-and-paste sufficiency vs paste-artifact inflation; the same paste-vs-natural evaluation settles both directions.
Distillation ceiling vs students exceeding teachers through multi-view fusion; a regime-mapping pair, not redundancy.
Recognition dominates residual error vs objectness binds for geometrically atypical classes; one oracle decomposition stratified by shape decides.
Objectness saturates early (favor classification pretraining) vs dense pretraining wins on small/dense strata; matched-compute comparison required.
Infinite procedural streams beat fixed datasets vs generator-support ceilings; the plateau measurements are shared infrastructure.

disagreements_vs_judge_A.why: Same removal direction, target differs: I fold into the in-wave renaming-reranks primary E-063 (which I keep); A points at E-029 citing the wave-1 C-052 ancestor. Either target preserves the content; Consolidator picks.
A merged into E-029; I keep: multi-word/phrase-composition degradation is a tokenization/composition claim with a paraphrase-recovery design, not a synonym-spread audit. Distinct kill, equally cheap.
Same direction; A names a dual primary (D-038+E-028), I name E-028 alone. No content difference.
A kept; I merge into D-003: withheld-vocabulary relabeling and present/absent score-overlap are two readouts of one abstention harness. Consolidator may keep separate for claim granularity.

A merged into D-085; I keep: tail-CI vacuity has its own decision consequence (long-tail leaderboard conclusions are noise) and its own stratification. Shared bootstrap harness flagged as co-run instead.
Both remove as the wave-1 C-047 port; A folds into D-085, I record the wave-1 target directly. Target choice is the Consolidator's.
A kept; I merge into E-029: tail-vs-head phrasing instability is one stratification of the same per-class synonym-spread measurement.

A merged into D-010; I keep: attribution/context-masking quantifies out-of-box reliance on natural images without composite curation; a different instrument from paste-into-atypical-scenes with different failure modes.
A merged into D-021; I keep: D-021 establishes the density crossover; D-079's falsifiable artifact is a two-feature per-image routing rule. Same stimuli (co-run), different claims.
A merged into D-095; I keep: counting-error concentration and detection FP/miss concentration are distinct task readouts over the same ambiguity-flagged pool (co-run).

A merged into E-046; I keep: last-layer-worst plus the pooling-pressure mechanism is the load-bearing base observation that E-046's query-conditional optimum presupposes. One probe rig, two claims (co-run).

A kept with a high-risk flag; I kill: known-result restatement risk (outlier/register-token line) is high enough that expected information per unit work is low. Feasibility itself is fine (T1); novelty judge may resurrect.

A merged into E-011; I keep: E-011 is about ensembling averaging spatially incompatible maps; E-045 is about single-template wording moving boundaries. The remedies differ (ensemble pruning vs template standardization).

A merged into E-029 as the wave-1 C-052 port; I keep it as the renaming-reranks-leaderboards primary (absorbing D-006), with the C-052 ancestor flagged for the novelty judge. Leaderboard-validity claim is distinct from consistency-audit claim.
A merged into D-096; I keep: expression re-annotation is a different instrument from box re-annotation; co-run in the shared annotation pool rather than merged.

A merged into F-027; I keep: F-027 tests convention-matched noise beating pixel-perfect labels; F-002 tests conflicting-convention mixtures and harmonization recovery - a mixing intervention with its own outcome.
A kept with a flag; I kill: recomputing normalization statistics on target data is an established test-time adaptation technique; the residual is a magnitude measurement with no belief at risk.
Same direction; A names dual primary (F-060+E-077), I name E-077 alone (its training-free correlational check comes first). No content difference.
A merged into F-086; I keep: the missing-pipeline-stage claim (test-set inflation plus train-redundancy) is decision-relevant beyond F-086's memorization mechanism. Shared retrieval harness (co-run).
